4.2.8 Error Handling
The modeling of error handling on the AUTOSAR adaptive platform slightly differs from
the approach implemented on the AUTOSAR classic platform.
In particular, the formal representation of an error during the execution of a method is
done in a global scope, i.e. such a definition can be reused arbitrarily by any ServiceInterface.
[TPS_MANI_01190] Semantics of ApApplicationError ⌈Meta-class ApApplicationError represents the ability to define the existence of an error during the
